2. (scripts/serial-design-chain-v2.tsx:280) — `attachActionLogger(outDir)` + `logAction` calls throughout (writes `actions.jsonl` with `action_type`/`cost_usd`/`before_hash` etc.); side-effect not mentioned.
3. (scripts/serial-design-chain-v2.tsx:340) — `generateBriefPlausibilityCritic` + `rewriteBriefWithRevision` (both FLASH_LITE) + `pickRevisionByPriority`/`parseRelaxFactor` inside the 3-iter refinement loop; concrete LLM entry points.
4. (scripts/serial-design-chain-v2.tsx:520) — `runPhysicsLedger` (G0) writes `state.physicsLedger` (verdict + hard/soft violations); deterministic first-principles check before any LLM physics critic.
5. (scripts/serial-design-chain-v2.tsx:780) — `runPhysicsCritic` (post-R3) writes `state.physicsCritique` (scores + high/med issues); separate from the R4 grounded reviewer.
6. (scripts/serial-design-chain-v2.tsx:1050) — `deriveHeadlineFromModules` populates `keyMetrics` + writes `9-headline-derived.json`; deterministic post-Phase-2 step.
7. (scripts/serial-design-chain-v2.tsx:1150) — `resolveDesignDecisions` + structural-gate router write `state.designDecisions` and `10-design-decisions.json`; also sets `acceptanceStatus` (`accepted_clean`/`accepted_with_decisions`/`not_accepted`).
8. (scripts/serial-design-chain-v2.tsx:1350) — `buildNaturalLanguageLayer` + `state.naturalLanguageLayer` + `briefOverviewProse` + `partVerificationSummary` + `engine_c_summary` + `deploymentEnvelope` written to final `state.json`.
9. (scripts/render-minimal-pdf.tsx:1180) — `RenderEngineBClassifier` (better-sqlite3 on `pretraining_extracted_parts`) provides runtime fallback for `engine_b_component_class` when older states lack the field.
10. (scripts/render-minimal-pdf.tsx:1420) — `SuppliersPage` reads `state.suppliers` (populated by absent `enrich-state-with-suppliers.tsx`); currently always empty but still wired into the render path.
11. (scripts/render-minimal-pdf.tsx:320) — imports/uses `getClassStandards` + `mergeBriefAndClassStandards`, `getClassHazards` + `computeHazardRPN`, `resolvePriceBand`, `resolveCostStack`/`computeCostStack` (all const tables read at render time).
